rules.statement: EBW begins only in 2023–2025, lasts at least four years and ends 31.12.2028.

result.description: Contract period is 6, 5, or 4 years ending 2028.

rules.statement: EBW and the optional regional plan must be requested in the multiple-application measure application by 31 December before the contract starts.

result.description: A valid contract may arise in the next year.

rules.statement: The claimant must farm an agricultural holding in its own name and for its own account, have control of claimed land, and meet active-farmer and agricultural-activity conditions.

conditions.expression: claimant.farms_in_own_name_and_account and claimant.has_land_control and claimant.active_farmer and claimant.agricultural_activity

result.description: General ÖPUL claimant prerequisite is met.

rules.statement: In the first ÖPUL year a farm needs either 0.50 ha protected cultivation or 1.50 ha total qualifying agricultural area; EBW also has its stricter own 1-ha participation threshold.

result.description: General first-year farm-size prerequisite is met.

rules.statement: At least 1.00 ha eligible EBW area is required in the first participation year; in later years at least one parcel must be managed to measure requirements.

result.description: Access threshold met.

rules.statement: Each EBW parcel requires a project confirmation from the BML-commissioned body, documenting binding detailed conditions and Anhang-K prerequisites.

result.description: Only confirmed arable or grassland parcels can participate.

rules.statement: A parcel must carry EBW in the field list and have an EBW reference area, the GIS graphical project confirmation, for payment.

conditions.description: Application code and graphical reference are present.

result.description: Parcel passes technical EBW application prerequisites.

rules.statement: Every binding indicator in the project confirmation must be achieved; additional indicators only qualify the target or serve training and are non-binding.

result.description: Parcel meets its project-defined requirements.

rules.statement: The specified indicators must be continuously observed and recorded in the coordinator's prescribed database structure.

result.description: Required observation record exists.

rules.statement: A field-management change inconsistent with prescribed indicators is allowed only after consulting the coordination office and written amendment of the project confirmation.

conditions.description: Planned field change deviates from project indicators.

result.description: Change may proceed only after written project-confirmation amendment.

rules.statement: Eligible arable and grassland parcels needing regular care must be used or cared for at least every second year.

result.description: Regular-care condition satisfied.

rules.statement: The farm manager, or an materially active person involved in management, must attend a regional networking meeting by 31.12.2026; confirmation must be supplied on request and one event cannot count twice.

result.description: Training obligation met.

rules.statement: The optional Regionaler Naturschutzplan requires an annual participation confirmation and compliance with its regional project indicators.

result.description: Option is eligible for its annual supplement.

rules.statement: The regional-plan supplement is EUR 270 per farm and year from 2024; simultaneous Naturschutz and EBW participation may receive it only once per farm and year.

result.description: EUR 270 per farm-year, once only.

rules.statement: For UBB/BIO biodiversity-area requirements, EBW arable fallow is creditable only with Grünbrache use and EBW plus DIV codes; listed grassland habitats may be DIVSZ-creditable, but EBW project conditions always remain controlling.

result.description: Credit is conditional and does not replace project confirmation.

rules.statement: EBW is combinable with Naturschutz and conversion of individual or all areas to Naturschutz was permitted only through 31.12.2025.

result.description: Later switch deadline is closed.

rules.statement: GLÖZ 4 vegetated buffer strips and GLÖZ 8 arable fallow through application year 2024 are not EBW-eligible on the affected part.

result.description: No EBW payment for affected parcel part.

rules.statement: EBW arable fallow is eligible only up to 25% of the farm's arable area, but at least 2.00 ha.

result.description: Eligible fallow amount capped.

rules.statement: EBW payment on a parcel cannot combine with another measure's single-parcel premium, except Natura 2000 and payment for landscape elements under UBB/BIO.

conditions.description: Other premium on the same parcel.

result.description: Only named exceptions remain payable.

rules.statement: Project confirmations select applicable objectives and indicators from the complete Annex-K catalog, including arable, grassland, animal, and neophyte/problem-plant indicators.

conditions.description: Indicator code is selected for the parcel.

result.description: Selected template is found in data/o6_19_ebw.json.

rules.statement: The base EUR/ha rate is selected from Annex K by land-use type, habitat, conservation status and, for meadows, difficulty class; all listed rows are preserved as data.

conditions.expression: premium habitat/status/difficulty has an Annex-K row

result.description: Annex-K base premium rate is returned.

rules.statement: EBBA01 is EUR 108/ha, once per area, for justified special effort; EBBA02 is EUR 162/ha from 2025 for habitats in very good conservation status, subject to the Annex-K eligibility/exclusion rules.

result.description: Applicable EBBA rate returned.

rules.statement: EBHG01/02 can add EUR 108/ha only for state-reported, AMA-GIS-mapped areas with at least 50% in the Schutzgutflächen layer.

result.description: EUR 108/ha supplement eligible.

rules.statement: General ÖPUL arable management requires proper cultivation, annual proper care, harvest and removal on at least 85% of the parcel, unless an applicable exception applies.

result.description: 85% harvest/removal standard applies.

rules.statement: EBW area accessions are fully payable in 2024–2025; later they are capped at 50% of 2025 area, while up to 5 ha growth is always allowed; pre-existing same-measure areas are not accessions.

result.description: Later accession fits statutory limit.

rules.statement: A multiannual EBW area reduction normally triggers repayment for affected areas; annual reduction is tolerated up to 5%, at most 5 ha, and always 0.50 ha, with stated transfer and land-use exceptions.

result.description: Affected difference areas are subject to repayment.

rules.statement: Failure of access conditions, reported areas, obligations, conditionality or multiannual duration can cause reductions; two 100% reductions during the contract lead to exclusion and recovery, while from 2027 a warning is replaced by 1% retention.

conditions.description: Verified violation of a funding obligation.

result.description: AMA assesses measure-level sanction under listed stages.

rules.statement: The aggregate area-payment cap for EBW/Naturschutz is EUR 1,500/ha from 2024 and EBW payment is modulated by total farm area at 100%, 90%, 85%, and 75% bands.

result.description: Weighted factor applies to EBW premium.

rules.statement: The 2026 third-use/early-use relief for UBB/BIO biodiversity areas does not relax EBW project-confirmation conditions for areas also in EBW.

conditions.expression: application_year = 2026 and parcel also has UBB/BIO biodiversity code

result.description: Continue to manage EBW parcel according to project confirmation.

rules.statement: For listed 2026 drought districts and normally late-summer/autumn harvested arable crops with no harvestable stand due to drought, the 85% harvest/removal requirement is waived without an individual force-majeure report and payment remains available.

conditions.expression: application_year = 2026 and drought_district_listed and late_harvest_crop and no_harvestable_stand_due_to_drought
conditions.description: All notice-specific exception facts must be documented.

result.description: No individual higher-force report is needed for the listed circumstance.
